reports.title: Cory Pass
reports.comment:
trip: Alp N aspects: 20 cm snow with some transport.
S to SW aspects: Most snow has melted.
NE aspect (2100 m): Found surface hoar (SH) up to 10 mm.

reports.title: Lazy day at Sunshine Meadows
reports.comment: trip: Snow pack was highly variable from place to place - everything from just 5cm of new snow on bare rock, to HS 50cm with 15 to 20cm of drifted snow above a thin melt-freeze crust with sugar below. Where present, the crust was supportive. Ski pen varied from near zero to 15cm. Wind varied from none to a light breeze. Reasonably heavy overcast. Deep drifted snow lulled me briefly into forgetting…

reports.title: Sunshine Meadows, Newfie Bowl
reports.comment:
trip: Weather: Sunny and calm.   

Snowpack: HS 35 cm in the meadows, from the surface down:

3–7 mm surface hoar on the surface
10 cm of low-density powder (no wind effect yet)
4 cm breakable temperature crust (1F-, soft) This layer will continue to facet out.
19 cm of low-density, sugary facets (F very soft)

Travel: Got a few good hesitant turns on grass bottom meadows. Only hit a few small roc…

reports.title: Rock Isle Gully
reports.comment:
trip: Skied the gully in the north east corner of Rock Isle Lake near Sunshine Village. The run itself was better than expected but still not a lot of snow there; around 45cm at the top was what I measured. The bottom of the gully is very rocky still. If that area gets at least another foot of snow, it will ski pretty well.

reports.title: Sunshine – Boundary Bowl, beside the slope
reports.comment:
trip: Weather: Cloudy, flat light.

Snowpack: HS ~35 cm at 2350 m. Very weak, loose snowpack with no real base. Poles hit the ground quickly, and rocks and shrubs are poking through nearby. Buried Surface hoar was present and felt very unstable. No distinct crust or layering was visible in the snow wall.

Travel: Skinned up beside the piste to Boundary Bowl (Great Divide Express). Coverage is thin…
